notes.title: MuX Beta Patch 180522
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Components
[list]
[*]lerps (utor, uton, rtou, rton, ntor, ntou)
Linearly interpolates between unit (0 to 1), range (X to Y) and normal (-1 to 1).
[*][i]uknob[/i] & [i]nknob[/i]
[*][i]toggleboard[/i]
[*][i]randomdispatch[/i]
[*][i]pass_in & pass_out[/i]
[/list]
    [*]Wiki
[list]
[*]Added a series of 'wiki' scenes. to enter the wiki, type: [code]loadx wiki[/code] or use press the [i]i[/i] button in the Hub.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Changes / Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated interaction system
[list][*]Fixed a issue where pressing a button really fast will cause it to not register a press.[/list]
[*]L_IZA
[list]
[*]Various fixes and improvements
[*] New command:[code]print "text"[/code]
makes L_IZA write some text to the console.
[*] The [i]txt[/i] command now accepts argument:[code]txt src:"source.txt"[/code]- where [i]source.txt[/i] is the path to a text file relative to your save folder.
[*]You can now paste text into L_IZA's console. simply copy some text to your clipboard, and press [b]ctrl+v[/b] while in MuX.
[*]You can now save your scene using the [b]ctrl+s[/b] keyboard shortcut.
[/list]
[*]Palette / Keyboard
[list][*]Added the up, down, left and right buttons, for navigating in the console. (Also works on your physical keyboard). 
Up and down cycles between previous and next in your command history.[/list]
[*]Components
[list]
[*]Many of the components now light up when firing an event.
[*]Various visual changes.
[*]Theremux
Visual updates, and now also outputs the angle of your trigger.
[/list]
[*]New Hub
[list][*]The hub has been redesigned with a lot more example scenes, featuring two scenes by community member [i]Zymf[/i][/list]
[*]Lift
[list]
[*]The playspace has been rotated 90 degrees, to better match the player's room-scale setup.
[*]The floor has been raised slightly, to better match the player's room-scale setup.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some of the spawning positons are incorrect
[*]Sometimes L_IZA and the Palette goes out of range of the Play Area
[*]Slides and wiki pages incomplete.
[/list]

[h1]Developer's comments[/h1]
[i]Dear MuX-icians:

With this new update, along with a bunch of new components, we have reworked the Interaction system, resulting in a much improved button-pressing experience. Instead of having to carefully touch a button, you can now press, poke, whack and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J9FImc2LOr8]slam[/url] to your heart's content!

We also added a major improvement to the visual feedback. Event components now light up when firing, making it easier to follow what is going on. 

We have also added the first version of our in-game Wiki. In the Wiki, you can read articles about all of the components, as well as various important concepts, such as connections, signals and commands. Some Wiki pages also feature examples, to help you understand the various concepts and components in MuX. To enter the wiki, either find the [b]i[/b] button in the Hub, or type [b]loadx wiki[/b] into L_IZA.

Please note that MuX is a work in progress, and everything is subject to change.

We hope you have fun with the new update, and we'd like to give a warm welcome to all of the new players who have joined us since the last update. Please feel free to share your thoughts and creations here in the steam forum, on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/mux/]reddit[/url], or on social media.
Stay MuX-y!

-The MuX team[/i]

notes.title: MuX Beta 180314
notes.content:
[b]MuX Beta 180314 Patch Notes: [/b]

[i]New Components:[/i]
[list]
[*]Sin
[*]Cos
[*]Floor
[*]Round
[*]Abs
[*]Sign
[/list]
[i]Changes / Additions:[/i]
[list]
[*]More settable types for Compare, Ifel and Watcher
[*]The knob board and the toggle board are now writable!
[*]HUB
[list]
[*]Added a bunch of new Demo scenes
[list]
[*]Now features a scene made by community member TiG3RMaST3R
[/list]
[*]Various changes to the Intro tutorial
[/list]
[*]Keyboard
[list]
[*]Added an "up" button to the keyboard, to recall the last command.
[*]Added "save" and "load" buttons on the keboard.
[*]Added a "HUB" button to the keyboard
[/list]
[*]L-IZA
[list]
[*]New Command: [i]info_mode (true / false)[/i]
[list]
[*]Disable to hide info display when hovering a component.
[/list]
[*]Removed the "console mode" button
[list]
[*]Now automatically displays console when typing.
[*]Now automatically displays info display when hovering a component.
[/list] 
[/list] 
[/list]
[i]Bugfixes / Improvements:[/i]
[list]
[*]General stability, usability and cosmetic improvements.
[*]Fixed an issue where event connections would become very large when passing a large number of events simultaneously.
[/list]

notes.title: MuX Beta Patch 180119
notes.content:
[b]MuX Beta 180119 Patch Notes:[/b]

[i]Features
[list]
    [*]New mobility option: Dragging
[list]
    [*]When not touching anything, hold TOUCHPAD + GRAB (side buttons) on one of your controllers to move around the space.
    [*]Your world position is retained when loading a new scene, unless specified in the save file.
[/list]
    [*]New Commands
[list]
    [*]New Command: cmd
Creates a cmd component. Shortcut for “spawn cmd” command.
    [*]New Command: txt
Creates a txt component. Shortcut for “spawn txt” command.

For more information on commands, see the [url=http://community.playmux.com/t/console-command-list/32] Command List Forum Thread.[/url]
[/list]
[/list]
Changes/Fixes/improvements
[list]
    [*]Various UX improvements
    [*]Various performance/stability improvements
    [*]Fixed an issue with the elbow and spacer
    [*]Octupus
[list]
    [*]Octopi can now be “rooted”. If rooted, it, and any components attached to it, will now follow you around if you move around using the new dragging feature.
    [*]In order to root an octopus, touch it and click the left button on your touch pad.
[/list]
   [*]L-IZA
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue with some pages not showing in Info mode.
    [*]Added missing pages to L-IZA.
[/list]
   [*]Demo Scenes
[list]
    [*]Added a new demo scene featuring musical scales.
[/list]
[/list]
[/i]

[url=http://community.playmux.com/t/mux-beta-180119/37]Click here to view this announcement on the MuX official Forums.[/url]
